title: AMD23 — Cerberus PM2 smoke: add cerberus-gateway to /smoke test suite
rationale: Cerberus gateway is in PM2 ecosystem but not checked by /smoke. Add check that verifies cerberus-gateway is online in PM2 and /health returns 200. Save cerberus_online + cerberus_health to smoke-test-latest.json.

tasks.description: In cmdSmoke() in scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-system.ts: add cerberus-gateway PM2 check (getPm2List, find cerberus-gateway by name) and HTTP health check (localhost:CERBERUS_PORT/cerberus/health, 3s timeout). Show result in smoke output lines. Update smoke-test-latest.json with cerberus_online and cerberus_health fields.
